name: blueprint/handoff-review
description: Review task handoffs before they count: collect done tasks, verify each outcome against evidence, accept or bounce, receipt the verdict
recipe: collect the done tasks -> verify each outcome against its evidence -> accept or bounce (with the reason on the task) -> receipt the review
pitfalls: a done task without evidence bounces back - the result field is the minimum
the review receipt is the verdict, not an opinion
bounced tasks stay open with the reason recorded
